dsh-cost-tracker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cf25ee1fcf37b66f80f5.html
